name: Camping 101: Herbalism

angles.text: As an herbalist, you can make Incense Candles from gathered wild herbs to aid spellcasters at camp.
As an Alliance herbalist, you can seek Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge for instruction in fieldcraft.
As a dwarf, you can find herbalism instructor Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge, where she teaches how to make Incense Candles.

faq.answer: Herbalists learn to put wild plants to practical use in camp. Reyna Stonebranch teaches the craft in Ironforge.
Reyna Stonebranch teaches proficient herbalists in Ironforge how to make Incense Candles for camp.
An Incense Candle brings a soothing aroma to camp and lifts the spirits of travelers.
faq.q: What does an Incense Candle do?

faq.answer: Its soothing aroma helps spellcasters and healers find a calmer place during long expeditions.
faq.q: Why are Incense Candles useful to spellcasters?

aliases: where do i go for camping herbalism
faq.answer: Herbalists travel to Ironforge to meet Reyna Stonebranch after proving their skill in gathering herbs.
faq.q: Where must herbalists travel for this instruction?

aliases: when can i learn incense candle
faq.answer: Herbalists must prove their skill in gathering herbs before Reyna Stonebranch teaches them to make Incense Candles.
faq.q: What is required before learning to craft the candle?

sections.body: Gathering wild herbs can serve a camp as well as a traveling party. With skill, herbalists turn what they gather into useful aids for life outdoors.
sections.title: Practical Field Botany

sections.body: In Ironforge, proficient herbalists can seek instruction from Reyna Stonebranch. Once they prove their skill, she teaches them to make an Incense Candle. Its soothing aroma lifts the spirits at camp and brings calm to spellcasters and healers on long expeditions.
sections.title: Aromatics for the Hearth

summary: In Ironforge, herbalists can learn to make Incense Candles for life in camp. Reyna Stonebranch teaches the craft to gatherers ready to put wild herbs to practical use.
